CustomField.description: Calculates the average of all CSAT-related rating fields to provide an overall satisfaction score. JIRA: SS‑13029
CustomField.formula: ( Overall_Satisfaction__c + Positive_Experience__c + Met_Expectations__c + Engineer_Knowledgable__c + Professional_Courteous_Responsive__c + Trusted_Provider__c ) / 6
CustomField.label: CSAT Score
